TanStack Router paginated list route (Ty.description:
Complete list route whose page number lives in the URL: the search schema owns it, loaderDeps makes the loader re-run on it, and the component reads the same query the loader filled. Requires @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/react-query, zod, a queryClient on the router context and a queryOptions factory of your own.

完整的列表路由，页码存放在 URL 中：search schema 拥有它，loaderDeps 让 loader 随之重新执行，组件读取 loader 已填充的同一个查询；需要 @tanstack/react-router、@tanstack/react-query、zod、router context 上的 queryClient，以及自建的 queryOptions 工厂。
